The '''29L electromagnetic countermeasures package''' was manufactured by [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]]. The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] sported such a device when it was owned by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
